controlled_provider_tests.scope: Executable server behavior with controlled provider I/O; includes price/mode validation, consent before URL release, payment attribution, refund and dispute behavior, fixed-anchor proration, recurring charge totals independent of paid capacity, and bounded invoice reconciliation.

actual_stripe_test_provider.payment_confirmation: Stripe hosted Checkout in a browser with synthetic accounts and test cards
actual_stripe_test_provider.database: Native local Supabase with synthetic workspaces
actual_stripe_test_provider.webhook_delivery: Actual provider Event objects fetched from Stripe and replayed through the application using a LOCAL test webhook signature; not remote delivery qualification

checks: Duplicate event acknowledged without granting twice
Recorded paid amount matches provider invoice
Actual renewal matches accepted fixed date
Payment does not exceed reviewed amount
Initial capacity period expires on fixed renewal
Stripe cancellation is scheduled at period end
Full refund removes only matching purchased packs
Failed renewal does not extend paid-through date
Failed invoice creates no capacity grant
suites.clock_limit: Stripe clock advanced into renewal; database clock remains real. Automatic expiry without an event is covered separately by SQL qualification.

shared_storage_database_qualification.scope: Combined storage and billing suite, not 85 billing-only checks; includes complete fresh migration replay, renewable commitment ceiling after a refund, and synthetic 115 GB/5,500-file capacity with five concurrent writers.

actual_stripe_cli_delivery.scope: Remote-origin signed event forwarding through official Stripe CLI to the production-mode local staging application; no locally constructed replay. The provider cancellation event automatically updated the capacity ledger while retaining current paid packs and all files. Hosted release endpoint delivery remains a deployment check.

release_requirements_still_separate: Normal release checks on the final committed revision
Remote Stripe webhook delivery to the release deployment
One concrete owner review of pricing, proration, USD/tax treatment, cancellation/refunds and operating limit
Explicit live-purchase activation after that approval
privacy: No card numbers, API keys, webhook secrets, login credentials, customer documents, or customer names are contained in this evidence.
